rationale: Per-sample GEO files (identical to the Rawcounts sheet of the series xlsx) combined into counts.tsv; guide-to-gene map from the Unassigned_1 gRNA sheet. Columns are named by GSM title (lib = plasmid input, P4 = in vitro passage 4 used to infect mice, WT_01..WT_10 = parasites recovered from the spleens of 10 wild-type mice at day 7). Primary analysis reproduces the paper's in vivo test (Wilcoxon of guide log2 fold changes, WT mice vs P4): 10 mice against the single P4 reference, ~ condition, 9 residual df, so the standard BARCS model applies; between-mouse variation sets the dispersion. Secondary: P4 vs plasmid (the paper's in vitro fitness score), one library each, zero residual df, so rho is pooled across all guides. The library has no non-targeting guides; its controls are in vitro essential and dispensable genes and the in vivo virulence genes ROP18 and GRA23, none of which is a null, so control_gene_pattern is unset and calibration cannot be checked. In vivo libraries are bottlenecked (35-50% of guides at zero in each mouse; the top 1% of guides hold 23-41% of reads), so library totals shift almost every gene to depletion; the primary analysis uses median-ratio totals (guides with reads in every library) and the library-total fit is kept as a sensitivity analysis.
